title: Patrick Henry Museum

services.name: Ticket
services.desc: Join Patrick Henry’s Red Hill and members of the descendant community for a tribute of Quarter Place to honor the life and legacy of the enslaved population of Red Hill and their descendants on September 26 from 11:00 am-3:30 pm. Please visit the ceremony event page for more information. Winter hours (Nov 1 - March 31) Monday - Saturday 9 am to 4 pm Sunday 1 pm to 4

blurb: Since 1944, the Patrick Henry Memorial Foundation has restored, maintained, and shared with the public Patrick Henry’s last home and burial site, along with the histories of Indigenous peoples, enslaved and free African Americans, and the Henry family.
